notes.title: Patch Notes | July 2025
notes.content:
Patch notes & Bug Fixes
Increased the range for the master branch audio bus.

Adjusted lighting in the convenience store.

Added a consistent camera position during a cutscene.

Adjusted the position of a readable note for easier interaction.

Added a failsafe for an occasional achievement sync issue.

Added a wider range for the mouse sensitivity slider.

Implemented a failsafe to ensure smooth camera movement during cutscenes. 

Added a failsafe to automatically remove items from the inventory when required. 

Enhanced NPC walking animations for smoother and more natural movement. 

Resolved mouse size issues, ensuring proper scaling on smaller screen resolutions. 

Applied multiple optimizations to audio levels based on player distance.
